# langsmith_tracing_key (Resource)

Manages a fixed-scope, ingestion-only LangSmith tracing key. Configure the provider with a control-plane API URL supporting service-account tracing-key management. The caller needs `workspaces:tracing-keys:create` in every selected workspace to create, and `workspaces:manage-keys` in every selected workspace or `organization:service-key:manage` to refresh, import, and delete. Human creators retain their existing management rights. Organization issuance and expiry policies apply. Changing description, workspace scope, or expiry replaces the key. The one-time secret is stored in Terraform state; protect state accordingly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider uses a service key or PAT with creation and management permissions.
# Each resource has a fixed workspace scope; protect Terraform state containing key.
resource "langsmith_tracing_key" "production" {
  description = "Production tracing"
  workspaces  = ["11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"]
  expires_at  = "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Key description. Changing this replaces the key.
- `workspaces` (Set of String) Nonempty set of workspace IDs as lowercase canonical UUIDs with hyphens. Scope never expands automatically. Changing this replaces the key.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp in RFC3339 format with at most six fractional digits (microsecond precision). Required when organization or deployment policy limits key lifetime. Changing this replaces the key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Human creator when available. Unset for service-account creation.
- `id` (String) Tracing key ID.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) One-time secret, available only after creation. Import cannot recover it.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last usage timestamp, when available.
- `short_key` (String) Redacted key.
- `workspace_names` (Set of String) Names of the selected workspaces.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import metadata by tracing key ID. The original secret cannot be recovered.
terraform import langsmith_tracing_key.production 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222
```
